scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:mcp
scripts.build:ext: node scripts/rust-assets.mjs && cd rust/ext && cargo run -q --manifest-path ../../vendor/oxichrome/oxichrome-cli/Cargo.toml -- oxichrome build --release
scripts.test:rust: cd rust && cargo test -q && cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -q -p reader-ext --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust && npm run build:ext && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust
